title: VT350 ·
model: lite-72, the printer with its e-box and EMU
foot: Real Blender Cycles renders (render.py, the render colour map, AgX Punchy, −1.4 EV), one every 10° round the printer at seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above, without the base board it stands on. The light turns with the camera. Drag sideways to turn it, up or down to change the height; arrow keys work too.
